note: Both Seth Meyers and The Daily Show remain on their extended summer hiatuses (back September 21 and September 8 respectively), so this week was a two-hander: Kimmel's slot, guest-hosted by Anthony Anderson, and Fallon. Both converged on the same story — reports that Trump was secretly moved into an airport catering truck to switch planes after a NATO summit in Turkey over a credible Iran assassination threat.

videos.title: Anthony Anderson's Guest Host Monologue on Jimmy Kimmel Live
Trump Snuck Off Air Force One in a Catering Truck After NATO Summit
#Trump hid in the back of a catering truck in Turkey… at least he has ONE exit plan.

jokes.topic: Trump being secretly moved into an airport catering truck to switch planes in Turkey
jokes.joke: That's the same way he used to get onto Epstein's plane. Now, I'm no security expert, but if I was trying to find Donald Trump, a catering truck is the first place I'd look.
jokes.context: Closed with: "Next time, hide his ass in a book-mobile!"

jokes.topic: Trump's noticeably fuller hair at a recent Red Rock Casino speech
jokes.joke: Looks like a $15 wig from Amazon.

jokes.topic: Trump defending his "dumocrats" nickname for Democrats
jokes.joke: Ummm, dumb does have a 'b,' it's just silent. Like Melania on your wedding night.

jokes.topic: Same catering-truck story, opening the show riding in on a catering cart pushed by fake Secret Service agents
jokes.joke: Today, everyone was like, 'Well, at least he has one exit plan.'
jokes.context: Played Trump like a kid on a road trip, also joking Trump hid in a catering truck while Marco Rubio hid in Trump's carry-on bag.

jokes.topic: Air Force One flying without Trump aboard for part of the trip
jokes.joke: Everyone knew Trump was off the plane, as it wasn't flying at its usual 45-degree angle.

jokes.topic: Karoline Leavitt resigning as White House press secretary after being left off the decoy plane
jokes.joke: Apparently, she's moving on to an easier job working as the press secretary for Taylor Farms lettuce.
jokes.context: Setup: "Karoline Leavitt was definitely one of the staffers left on Air Force One. It's like, 'Oh, really? You didn't take me?'" — the lettuce reference doubled as a jab at Taylor Farms' ongoing cyclospora recall.
